stories.title: Provisioning runner must complete all 15 steps + seed legal pages + site_categories on production
stories.rootCause: MQA-5 evidence: live prod D1 shows max 8/15 site_creation_job_steps per site (5 sites checked); 0 pages WHERE page_type='legal'; 0 site_categories. REQ-005 (15 deterministic steps), REQ-019 (resumable runner to completion), REQ-020 (legal page seed during provisioning), REQ-026 (default site_categories seed) all unsatisfied at runtime. Local wrangler dev path (MQA-4) executes all 15 + idempotent 16th, so divergence is environment-specific: either (a) production worker lacks the seeded migration data, (b) provisioning runner halts after step 8 due to a prod-only env/perm condition, or (c) legal/category seed steps were implemented only in a dry-run code path that prod doesn't exercise.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: cd api && wrangler d1 execute kodigital-homepages-cms-db --remote --json --command "SELECT site_id, count(*) AS n FROM site_creation_job_steps GROUP BY site_id HAVING n=15" -- at least 1 site with full 15 steps post-provision
AC2: cd api && wrangler d1 execute kodigital-homepages-cms-db --remote --json --command "SELECT count(*) FROM pages WHERE page_type='legal'" >= 2
AC3: cd api && wrangler d1 execute kodigital-homepages-cms-db --remote --json --command "SELECT count(*) FROM site_categories" >= 1

AC4: BEHAVIORAL: POST /api/admin/sites against production (with CF Access service token) creates a site whose provisioning runner reaches step 15 of 15 within 60 seconds; 16th call is idempotent (no new step row)
AC5: FUNCTIONAL: identify the diverging code path between dry-run and live (categories + legal seed) — single non-dry-run branch executes all seed steps
stories.verification: cd api && npm test -- provisioning-runner --reporter=verbose; then wrangler d1 execute --remote SELECT count(*) FROM site_creation_job_steps WHERE site_id=<test site> = 15
stories.rollback: Revert MQAFIX-1 commits; document gap as PRODUCT_BUG_CONFIRMED in next /a2z-ship cycle.
stories.introduced_by: T4 / T6 / T7 implementation (provisioning + about/legal pages + categories seed) — local wrangler-dev verified but production data path diverges

stories.title: Media + Tags list handlers must include WHERE site_id clause in SQL
stories.rootCause: MQA-10 source review: api/src/admin/api.ts:201-213 SELECT statements for media and tags lists do NOT bind site_id into the WHERE clause despite REQ-010/011 calling for site-aware filtering (media returns site + global rows; tags returns site rows only). Endpoints currently respond HTTP 200 with valid schemas (verified) but discrimination is unprovable in production because both tables are empty. Latent bug: when data exists for ≥2 sites, the handlers will leak cross-site rows.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: grep -nE 'WHERE.*site_id|where.*site_id' api/src/admin/api.ts -- lines 201-213 (or equivalent media/tags list handler block) MUST contain WHERE site_id bind expression

AC2: BEHAVIORAL test: seed media rows for site_A AND site_B AND a global (site_id IS NULL). GET /api/admin/media?site_id=<A> returns ONLY site_A + global rows (NOT site_B). GET /api/admin/tags?site_id=<A> returns ONLY site_A rows (NOT global, NOT site_B).
AC3: cd api && npx vitest run test/admin-media-site-filter test/admin-tags-site-filter -- exit 0
AC4: FUNCTIONAL: confirm no SQL injection vector — site_id MUST be bound via .bind(siteId), NOT template-literal-interpolated (per .claude/rules/d1-database-safety.md)
stories.verification: Seed test data + curl with site_id query param + assert response row counts; SQL audit
stories.rollback: Remove WHERE site_id clauses (revert to current code).
stories.introduced_by: T9 + T10 stories declared site-aware filtering as their AC but the handler SQL doesn't bind site_id parameter

DB-side provisioning matches spec (1 about + 4 legal pages for the test site). Spec-literal grep against the active template fails. Either harmonize to site_id (matches T6.AC1) or update T6.AC1 to accept name=site as semantically equivalent.

AC2: grep -nE 'name="site"' api/src/admin/templates/pages.ts | wc -l == 0 (avoid double-rendering)
AC3: BEHAVIORAL: GET /admin/pages → HTML response body contains literal substring '<select' AND 'name="site_id"' together (regex test)
AC4: Decide canonical: delete views/pages.ts if dead OR keep + document why two templates exist

stories.title: MQA-3 side fixes: seed verticals on fresh D1 + client polling reads body.resource.id (not body.id)
stories.rootCause: Two side defects surfaced during MQA-3 PASS verdict: (a) New Site modal's vertical dropdown renders with 0 <option> elements on fresh local D1 — the GET that populates verticals returns empty rows because the verticals seed migration is not auto-run on fresh local D1 (or the seed is missing); (b) provisioning-polling client code reads body.id (undefined) to construct the poll URL — the actual server response shape is {resource: {id: 'st_xxx', ...}}. The double-undefined leads to poll URL ending in '/provision/status//' → 404. Did not block MQA-3 main verdict because the test sequence pre-populated verticals manually and observed the network POST directly, but UX-wise the flow is broken.
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: cd api && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler d1 execute kodigital-cms-local --local --json --command 'SELECT count(*) FROM verticals' returns >= 1 (verticals seeded automatically)
AC2: BEHAVIORAL: Playwright opens /admin/domains, clicks New Site, asserts vertical dropdown has >= 1 <option> on a fresh local D1 (no manual pre-seed)
AC3: grep -nE 'body\.resource\.id' api/src/admin/static/domains-create-site.js | wc -l >= 1 (client reads resource.id)
AC4: grep -nE '\.body\.id|body\[.id.\]' api/src/admin/static/domains-create-site.js | wc -l == 0 (no longer reading .body.id)
AC5: BEHAVIORAL: After POST /api/admin/sites, client polling URL contains the actual site_id (no '//' double-slash, no 404 on poll endpoint)
stories.verification: Playwright spec domains-create-site.spec.ts asserts vertical dropdown populated + polling URL is well-formed
stories.rollback: Revert seed migration + client polling change.
stories.introduced_by: T3 + T2 implementation — verticals seed not part of base migrations; client/server response shape disagreement
